entities.description: A full-body shot of a standing Black man, likely of Maasai ethnicity, wearing a vibrant red shuka wrapped around his body and secured with a white belt. He is adorned with elaborate jewelry, including multiple strands of blue and white beaded necklaces with metal pendants, silver bracelets on both wrists, and a single feather headdress on his head, set against a dry, outdoor background with sparse trees.

accessories.necklace: blue and white beads with metal pendants

entities.description: A full-body shot of a standing man with dark skin and a shaved head, wearing a red patterned wrap garment and multiple strands of white beaded necklaces with metal pendants. He has a single feather attached to the top of his head, a white beaded belt with a white cloth tie, and a metal bracelet on his left wrist, standing barefoot on dry, straw-covered ground.
